extracted.intended_audience: peer reviewers and researchers in molecular biology/aging (C. elegans actin cytoskeleton, grant reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: A K99/R00 research proposal describing experiments to interrogate actin cytoskeletal form and function during aging in C. elegans, including genetic perturbations, biochemical tool development (proximity labeling, single-cell westerns), sequencing, lipid assays, and lifespan/thermotolerance measurements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualitative filament structure/integrity measurement using LifeAct-mRuby
rubrics_metrics.description: Filament structure and integrity will be qualitatively measured in vivo in muscle, intestine, and hypodermis of animals with knockdown or overexpression of bet-1 throughout age at Day 1, D4, D7, D10, and D13 (n > 50 animals per condition; >2 independent trials using 3 aging methods for >6 total replicates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use LifeAct-mRuby lines; perform measurements across specified ages and tissues; use three aging methods (see aging methods rubric); ensure >50 animals per condition and >2 independent trials yielding >6 total replicates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aging methods (experimental approaches)
rubrics_metrics.description: Animals are aged using the following methods: 1) adults washed off plates and eggs/progeny aspirated away; 2) chemical sterilization with FUDR; 3) adults manually picked away from progeny.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use multiple aging methods to ensure robustness; consider all three approaches and combine results across methods to produce >6 total replicates per condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Muscle actin filament thickness quantification
rubrics_metrics.description: Thickness of muscle actin filaments measured (n > 30 animals per condition; filaments in 1 muscle cell quantified per animal for >100 measurements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify filaments in one muscle cell per animal to accrue >100 measurements per condition; ensure n>30 animals per condition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated fluorescent intensity (COPAS biosorter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrated fluorescent intensity of actin measured using a COPAS large particle biosorter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect high-throughput fluorescence measurements (for some assays n > 500 animals per condition); use COPAS to quantify whole-animal or tissue-specific integrated signal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect intestinal F-actin measurement (LifeAct filament:cytoplasm ratio)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indirect measurement of intestinal F-actin using ratio of LifeAct in filaments vs. cytoplasm (for 2 & 3: n > 500 animals per condition).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute filament:cytoplasm ratios from LifeAct signal; aim for very large sample sizes (n>500) and >3 independent trials where specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actin dynamics measured by FRAP
rubrics_metrics.description: Dynamics of actin measured using fluorescent recovery after photobleaching (FRAP) of LifeAct in muscle, intestinal, and hypodermal actin (n > 30 animals per condition; 3-5 structures measured per animal for >100 measurements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run statistics on t=1/2 measurements; perform >3 independent trials per experiment; use Mann-Whitney testing for significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation of knockdown experiments in null mutants
rubrics_metrics.description: All knockdown experiments will be validated in null mutants synthesized by CRISPR-Cas9-mediated gene editing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complement RNAi/knockdown data with CRISPR-generated null mutants to confirm phenotypes are due to target gene loss.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lifespan and thermotolerance assay standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Lifespans & thermotolerance on >120 adult animals per condition; >3 independent trials; log-rank testing for significance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use sufficiently large cohorts (>120 adults) and multiple independent trials; analyze survival with log-rank tests (Kaplan-Meier comparisons).

rubrics_metrics.name: Genetic dependency/suppression testing via RNAi
rubrics_metrics.description: Treat bet-1 overexpressing strains with RNAi targeting actin and known actin-regulating genes (e.g., tropomyosins, the ARP2/3 complex, formins) to determine whether loss of broad and specific actin regulatory genes is sufficient to attenuate the lifespan extension found in bet-1 overexpressing animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use RNAi to test whether lifespan/cytoskeletal effects of bet-1 overexpression are actin-dependent; interpret suppression as evidence of dependency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contingency strategies for non-significant overexpression effects or toxicity
rubrics_metrics.description: If bet-1 overexpression does not extend lifespan or is toxic, perform single-copy overexpression (mosSCI), tissue-specific overexpression, or overexpression of specific isoforms to titrate expression and test tissue/isoform-specific effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan alternative expression strategies to distinguish dose/toxicity vs biological lack-of-effect and to probe tissue- or isoform-specific functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Testing MYST HAT dependence (mys-1/mys-2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interrogate cytoskeletal quality in animals with mys-1 and mys-2 knockdown using similar strategies proposed in Aim 1.1a; prediction: knockdown of mys-1 or mys-2 should mimic defects in cytoskeletal health and lifespan found in bet-1 knockdown; bet-1 knockdown should not further abrogate health/lifespan in mys-1 or mys-2 knockdown animals; mys-1/mys-2 knockdown may suppress bet-1 overexpression benefits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use epistasis-like logic: similarity of phenotype implies shared pathway; lack of additive effect indicates same pathway. Design experiments to detect suppression or epistasis.

rubrics_metrics.name: BET-1::GFP nuclear localization as functional readout
rubrics_metrics.description: Test BET-1::GFP localization in animals at D1, D4, D7, D10, and D13 (n > 50 animals per condition; >2 trials per aging method for >6 total replicates). Quantification measured as % integrated fluorescence of nucleus:cytoplasm. Mann-Whitney statistical testing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use nuclear:cytoplasmic fluorescence ratios as proxy for transcriptional activity; sample sizes and stat test as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChIP-seq / RNAseq / ATAC-seq replication and analysis standards
rubrics_metrics.description: All ChIP-seq will be performed with guidance; 5 biological replicates of >500 animals for all sequencing analysis – ChIP-seq, RNAseq, and ATAC-seq. Reads will be mapped using bowtie2, and SAMtools, deepTools, and macs2 for calling peaks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect multiple biological replicates and large pooled numbers of animals per replicate; use specified bioinformatics pipeline tools (bowtie2, SAMtools, deepTools, macs2) and collaborators for analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of ATAC-seq to measure global chromatin accessibility during aging
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform ATAC-seq on animals during the aging process (D1, D4, D7, D10, D13) to determine changes in chromatin state and compare to mys-1/mys-2 knockdown to see if knockdown phenocopies chromatin deterioration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ATAC-seq to assay chromatin state longitudinally and in genetic perturbations; analyze with bowtie, SAMtools, bedtools, MACS for peak calling.

rubrics_metrics.name: RNAseq analysis pipeline and promoter mining
rubrics_metrics.description: If ChIP/BETr-1::GFP experiments do not yield changes, perform RNAseq in bet-1 knockdown and overexpression animals. Reads aligned and quantified using salmon with WBcel235 as worm reference genome. Fold changes determined using R-package DESeq2. Subsequent promoter mining of cytoskeletal targets may reveal putative transcription factor binding motifs of BET-1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use salmon for quantification and DESeq2 for differential expression; perform promoter motif analyses to identify candidate transcriptional targets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure actin form/function in lipid regulator overexpression
rubrics_metrics.description: Measure actin form and function during aging in animals with daf-16 or nhr-49 overexpression as described in Aim 1.1a; determine whether daf-16 and nhr-49-mediated lifespan extension is dependent on functional actin by testing whether RNAi knockdown of actin regulators suppresses lifespan effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply same actin assessment pipelines to lipid regulator genetic manipulations; interpret suppression as indication of actin-dependence for lifespan effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organismal lipid level measurement standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Measure organismal lipid levels in animals with defective actin cytoskeleton by using BODIPY and Nile Red staining using fluorescent microscopy and flow cytometry with a COPAS biosorter (n > 500 animals per condition; >3 independent trials; Mann-Whitney testing for statistics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use established lipid dyes and COPAS biosorter for high-throughput quantification; aim for n>500 per condition and multiple trials; Mann-Whitney for comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lipid droplet morphology quantification
rubrics_metrics.description: For lipid droplet morphology, >50 animals per sample; >10 lipid droplets analyzed per animal for >500 measurements; analyses made on size, density, and quantity of lipid droplets; Mann-Whitney testing for statistics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect sufficient numbers of droplets and animals to achieve >500 measurements; quantify multiple morphological features and use nonparametric stats as specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: qPCR experimental standards
rubrics_metrics.description: qPCR experiments are performed with 4 technical replicates of each 3 biological replicate collected from >1,000 animals. qPCR measurements are made against a standard curve and normalized to major C. elegans housekeeping genes, pmp-3, sap-49, and Y45F10D.4; a two-group t-test will be used for statistical analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use large pooled samples (>1,000 animals), include technical replicates, use standard curves and specified housekeeping genes for normalization; use two-group t-tests for comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: H4 acetylation measurement by IP-mass spec
rubrics_metrics.description: H4 acetylation status will be tested by H4 immunoprecipitation followed by mass-spec; 5 biological replicates of >100,000 animals will be collected and analyzed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect very large pooled samples for histone mass-spec; run multiple biological replicates and work with experienced mass-spec collaborators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proximity labeling tool development (LifeAct::miniTurbo::degron)
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop LifeAct::mRuby::miniTurbo::degron constructs for tissue-specific and temporally controlled proximity-dependent biotin labeling of actin interactors; validate spatial/temporal control and efficacy before pulldown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use tissue-specific promoters, auxin-degron temporal control (remove auxin 24 hours prior to collection), validate localization and non-perturbation of actin structure; include cytoplasmic miniTurbo controls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proteomics pulldown and TMT-MS standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Purify biotinylated proteins to identify actin interacting partners using TMT labeling coupled to quantitative MS/MS analyses. Analysis will be performed with collaborators using X! Tandem, Scaffold Q, and SafeQuant (run analysis on 6 independent replicates of >100,000 worms per sample).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use anti-actin probing as initial validation (expect massive enrichment); multiplex with TMT; run multiple independent biological replicates with large pooled numbers of animals; collaborate with mass-spec core for analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tissue/timepoint sampling plan for proximity labeling
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform pulldowns and mass-spec at young and old adult animals: for muscle and intestine collect at D1 and D10; for hypodermis collect at D3 and D7. Include positive controls (young-age animals treated with perturbations that mimic aging: tropomyosin knockdown for muscle, arp-2/3 inhibition for hypodermis, actin knockdown for intestine).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timepoint and tissue-specific sampling to detect aging-associated interactome changes; include validated perturbations as positive controls to benchmark changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: RNAi screens and synthetic lethality for candidate gene discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform RNAi screens to identify genes that perturb cytoskeletal integrity in muscle, intestine, hypodermis, and perform synthetic lethality screening with mutants of hsf-1 or animals exposed to actin-destabilizing chemicals, heat, or actin knockdown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage high-throughput screening expertise to generate candidate lists for proteomic follow-up; then measure impact on longevity for hits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Caveat for tissue-specific promoter leakiness and alternative plans
rubrics_metrics.description: During aging, tissue-specific promoters may become leaky; as an alternative perform proximity labeling in animals harboring knockdown or overexpression of genes identified in Aim 1 and determine impact on actin interactome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan alternative experimental designs that do not depend solely on promoter specificity at late ages; include genetic perturbation conditions as complementary approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-cell western blot (scWB) method for F:G actin quantification
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop scWB protocols: serial lysis (F-actin stabilization buffer to preserve F-actin, electrical separation of G-actin into gel, UV immobilization, denaturation to depolymerize F-actin, reverse current to resolve F-actin), followed by immunoprobing to quantify F- and G-actin per cell.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assay hundreds of cells per slide; validate with known cell lines and pharmacological perturbations (jasplakinolide, latrunculin A).

rubrics_metrics.name: scWB validation and replication criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Validate scWB on MDA-MB-231 and BJ fibroblast lines; collected data on over 22 replicates with sample sizes 43–234 cells per replicate and use Kruskal-Wallis testing to confirm no significant run-to-run differences. For human gene conservation tests use n > 200 cells per condition and ensure >5 replicates show nonsignificant differences using Kruskal-Wallis for each mutant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform many replicates and sufficiently large per-replicate cell numbers; use nonparametric statistics to ensure assay run-to-run variability is insignificant relative to biological effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: scWB caveats and optimization strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: CAVEAT: Trypsinization used to move adherent cells into microwells may cause artifacts. Optimization strategies: 1) use suspension Jurkat cell-lines to test trypsinization artifact, 2) on-chip culturing and lysis to avoid preparation steps (ECM-coated polyacrylamide gels and microwell arrays to culture cells directly).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement and test alternative cell handling to avoid preparation-induced cytoskeletal artifacts; include controls to detect preparation effects.
